title: Open-unit normalization of the transported proper/open map
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, X,T1,T2 schemes, r:T1→T2 proper, and ji:X→Ti open immersions with j1≫r=j2. Let L be a bounded-below etale derived A-module on X. Define properOpenRestriction on unbounded pro-etale derived A-modules by the inverse-image compositor for this equality followed by j1 inverse image of the proper counit. For K=ν_X^* L, the open-adjunction transpose of properOpenProEtaleIso A r j1 j2 h L, followed by properOpenRestriction at j1!K, equals the open unit K→j1^*j1!K. This is before any intrinsic constant-ring or finite coefficient realization.

proof.text: The etale comparison is the transpose of the inverse proper/open identification. Apply the hom-equivalence inverse law and properOpenIdentification_unit, then cancel the identification and its inverse. This gives its restriction equation on D+.

theorem properOpenProEtaleIso_unit
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X T₁ T₂ : Scheme.{u}} (r : T₁ ⟶ T₂) [IsProper r]
    (j₁ : X ⟶ T₁) (j₂ : X ⟶ T₂) [IsOpenImmersion j₁] [IsOpenImmersion j₂]
    (h : j₁ ≫ r = j₂)
    (L : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
    (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j₂).homEquiv _ _
        (properOpenProEtaleIso A r j₁ j₂ h L).hom ≫
      (properOpenRestriction A r j₁ j₂ h).app
        ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j₁).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).mapDerivedCategory.obj L.obj)) =
    (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j₁).unit.app
        ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).mapDerivedCategory.obj L.obj)
